intent: A source that names the public Agent Plugins specification is held to it, so plugin facts are recorded only for a manifest that actually conforms, and a source that names another specification is still imported.
observable_outcome: A manifest declaring the canonical schema and breaking any of its field rules refuses the whole source and names the field; a manifest declaring another specification is disclosed and its skills import as a directory tree.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A manifest declaring the canonical schema whose author is not an object of only name, email and url as strings refuses the source, names the offending field, and discovers no component.
An extensions field that is not an object is disclosed at info level and ignored, and the plugin still loads its skills.
A manifest declaring another specification, none, or invalid JSON is disclosed and the source is read as a directory tree, so its skills still import.
